experience.title: Marketing Analyst
bullets: Compiled weekly sales and campaign reports by hand, spending hours reconciling spreadsheets before each Monday planning meeting.
Taught herself Python and pandas to automate the reporting process after a formatting error delayed a quarterly review.

projects.title: Global Superstore Sales Analysis
bullets: Analyzed profit, sales and profit ratio across a multi-year sales dataset, identifying patterns worth flagging to a merchandising team.
Presented findings in a format aimed at non-technical stakeholders, translating profit-ratio trends into a short set of recommendations.

projects.title: Customer Segmentation Ecommerce Department Store
bullets: Segmented e-commerce customers by purchase and transaction behavior, translating cluster results into descriptions a non-technical reader could use.

projects.title: Customer Lifetime Value Prediction Regression
bullets: Built a regression model estimating customer lifetime value from spending and product history to flag high-value customers.
